summary: Strengthen human-rights governance, escalation and reporting with practical leadership exercises. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Human rights leadership training helps executives, human-rights officers and managers turn rights commitments into accountable decisions and oversight. Using the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights and the ILO Declaration as reference points, learners practise mapping decision ownership, prioritizing impacts, and designing worker-concern escalation and remedy oversight. They also set indicators and prepare a leadership brief with evidence for review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who make, advise on or document decisions affecting human rights. It suits foundation-level learners who need a practical way to connect rights commitments with governance, escalation and follow-up.
prerequisites: No formal human-rights qualification is required. Familiarity with organizational roles, policies or decision processes is useful; coding or programming is not required.
